outcome: Pregnancy complications related to uterine surgery
cohort: 63 nulliparous women with primary unexplained infertility, repeated in vitro fertilization (IVF) failure or recurrent spontaneous miscarriage and a T-shaped uterus anomaly not related to diethylstilbestrol
finding: Hysteroscopic metroplasty appears effective in improving reproductive outcomes in women with primary reproductive failure and a T-shaped uterus.
